com-contracts.scope: Fresh disconnected filters, STA and MTA, class factory and IUnknown identity, standard interface availability, selected custom IIDs through IUnknown only, initial state/name/class/clock, property-page UUIDs, stream count, pin names/directions/IDs/parent identity, FindPin and enumerator reset/clone/skip. No registration, custom interface methods, media negotiation, graph playback or UI. Constructor settings writes are confined to each private volatile HKCU key. Autoloader pin-ID operations are excluded from reference parity and checked separately on the candidate. Two reference and two candidate processes per case; unstable, crashed, timed-out or incomplete runs are failures.
com-contracts.settings_environment: Private volatile HKCU per worker, removed by parent after termination; native constructor writes are isolated.
